accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out >= 0 and out <= cap and out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(0, [1, 2]) == 0
  ex accepted(2, [1, 2, 3]) == 2
  ex accepted(5, [1, 2]) == 2
  -- This toolchain has no channel type, so the channel is modelled by a
  -- count of occupied slots. A send is accepted while a slot is free.
  var n = 0
  for i in range(0, xs.len())
    if n < cap
      n += 1
    else
      break
  n
